purpose: Capture a sanitized read-only baseline for the existing zhongshu entrance and stop before the separately authorized maintenance-window cutover.
allowed_operations: active configuration SHA-256 calculation without reading configuration content into reports
secret-pattern scan that emits counts only
prohibited_actions: stop or modify the zhongshu Core Binding
start, stop, or restart Project Gateway or OpenClaw Gateway
connect to Feishu or OpenClaw RPC
modify production configuration, Agent, Cron, OAuth, model, PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
commit, push, tag, or create P0_READY
rollback: Read-only snapshot work has no runtime state to restore.
secrets: Only hashes, counts, booleans, and safe timeout states are recorded; no config contents, credentials, raw Feishu identifiers, or endpoint values are emitted.
